task.title: EACQ-FV L1 Pre-Closure Base Range Dispatch Guard
task.objective: Reject dispatch-ready no-commit work orders that pin a pre-closure HEAD range to their dispatch base, while preserving safe commands and explanatory prose.
nonGoals: Do not change autorun runtime behavior, governed standards, hooks, catalogs, roadmaps, or session state.
Do not rewrite historical closed work orders or create a parallel checker.
Do not open MV-3 or UAA.
Do not commit, push, publish, deploy, call providers, or use credentials.

gateA.name: SOURCE_OWNER_OVERLAP
requiredEvidence: Read the template base-anchor rule, literal-format gotcha 12, three recurring worker-return findings, checker owner, and autorun owner.
Confirm dispatch base ancestry, pinned hashes, exact three-path write ownership, and empty staging.
Confirm the missing layer is pre-dispatch validation and not runtime range-shape enforcement.
Confirm no parallel dispatch-quality owner exists.

gateB.name: DESIGN_CODE_TEST
requiredEvidence: Reject literal and symbolic dispatch-base reuse in executable pre-closure HEAD commands.
Preserve safe pre-implementation and distinct-material-base commands.
Ignore explanatory prose outside Verification Commands.
Run the six focused cases and dispatch-quality regression gate.
Return exact changed-set, size, and empty-staging evidence.
